intro: Valor's Rest is a small outpost and cemetery perched at the eastern threshold of Silithus. Guarded by members of the Cenarion Circle, it is the first point of shelter seen by travelers emerging from Un'Goro Crater into the windswept wastes.

p: Perched on the eastern border of Silithus along the ramp leading down from Un'Goro Crater, Valor's Rest serves as the threshold into this desolate frontier. Maintained as a neutral staging ground by the Cenarion Circle, the camp hosts members of both the Alliance and the Horde who dare to brave the arid wastes. Its prominent graveyard stands as a somber reminder of the danger lurking throughout the desert, where insectoid horrors and ancient threats test even the hardiest expeditions.
